def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    barriers=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==2 for v in row)]
    toward_up=bool(barriers and barriers[0] < h//2)
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c] in (0,2) or (r,c) in seen: continue
        col=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append((col,cells))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if barriers:
      br=barriers[0]
      out[br]=[2]*w
    poses=[cells[:] for _,cells in comps]
    while True:
      occ={p:i for i,ps in enumerate(poses) for p in ps}; moved=False
      order=sorted(range(len(poses)),key=lambda i:(min(y for y,x in poses[i]) if toward_up else -max(y for y,x in poses[i])))
      for i in order:
        ps=poses[i]; dy=-1 if toward_up else 1
        if all(0<=y+dy<h and (y+dy,x) not in occ for y,x in ps):
          for p in ps: occ.pop(p,None)
          poses[i]=[(y+dy,x) for y,x in ps]
          for p in poses[i]: occ[p]=i
          moved=True
      if not moved: break
    for (col,_),ps in zip(comps,poses):
      for y,x in ps: out[y][x]=col
    return out
